title: Health Processor
keywords: Collects recipe-defined health nutrient or existing health-module contents and fills a destination module

blocks.text: Collects recipe-defined health nutrient or existing health-module contents and fills a destination module. Matching Tanzanite networks can supply leaf nutrient.

rows: Inspect the current Health Processor value recipes.
Place the destination Health/Nutrition Module in its module slot.
Connect compatible leaves and keep the traversal loaded and permitted.

blocks.text: Not every edible item is a health source. The health program uses its own value recipes.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
